title: CultureRoute
tagline: An agentic cultural shortlist with Qloo evidence attached.
inspiration: Cultural discovery is more useful when recommendations can be traced to public references rather than presented as unexplained personal predictions.
whatItDoes: Uses public books, films and artists as starting points for a cultural shortlist. An Eve agent calls the official Qloo harness workflow, returns the actual result, asks for clarification when needed and supports owned result export.
howItWasBuilt: The official Qloo harness exec entry point runs in-process with a restricted environment and a fixed recommend workflow. Eve exposes a typed discovery tool; Next.js presents the assistant and result view, and PostgreSQL stores owned records.
technicalEvidence: Local automated verification is included in this repository. Real provider calls, cloud deployment and browser end-to-end verification remain pending.
authorship: Prepared with ChatGPT/Codex assistance. Shared Next.js/workspace infrastructure originates in code-up-matrix/axios-fx-compliance-agent; the product module was developed on 27 October 2026. Shared code must be disclosed under the event’s reuse rules.
eligibility: Actual Qloo plus agentic framework integration, MIT source and demonstrable user flow. Event credential and live recording are missing.
judgeAccessInstructions: Provide the private judging access code through the submission portal after live verification. Do not put it in public source.
challenges: A command-line integration must remain traceable and runnable after serverless packaging. The real harness is exercised by the packaging test, and user input is never executed as a shell command.
accomplishments: The standalone Eve and Next.js builds pass, including a real harness help invocation and ownership tests. Actual Qloo requests and agent runtime behavior remain to be verified with event credentials.
lessons: Cultural affinity is aggregate evidence, not a sensitive-trait inference or a guarantee about an individual. Ambiguous references need clarification.
next: Connect the event-issued Qloo key and AI Gateway authentication, demonstrate a real agent tool call, then capture the shortlist and its returned entity identifiers.
judgeFit: Combines the required Qloo workflow with an agent framework in a specific user task. The submission needs actual tool-call evidence and a working demo.
demo: Ask the assistant for a shortlist from public cultural references.
Show a real Qloo tool invocation and returned entity IDs.
Clarify an ambiguous match and refine the result.
Export the record and show an honest provider error.
